python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv, json, collections, glob
plan={r['run_id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('plan.csv'))}
launch={r['run_id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('launch_log.csv'))}
res={r['run_id']:float(r['pass_rate']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('eval_results.csv'))}
rt={r['run_id']:r['finished_at'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('runtime.csv'))}
retd={r['run_id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('retention_log.csv'))}
rec={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('recovered/*.csv')):
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(f)): rec[r['run_id']]=float(r['pass_rate_pct'])/100
def insink(k):
    w=launch[k]['worker']; st=launch[k]['started_at']
    if w in('w03','w07') and '2026-06-27T00:00:00Z'<=st<'2026-07-03T12:00:00Z': return '4471'
    if w=='w09' and '2026-07-11T00:00:00Z'<=st<'2026-07-15T00:00:00Z': return '4530'
    return None
# consistency checks
print('sink runs with results row:',[k for k in launch if insink(k) and k in res])
print('sink runs in retention:',[k for k in launch if insink(k) and k in retd])
print('sink runs recovered:',collections.Counter(insink(k) for k in rec if k in launch and insink(k)))
print('dropped_at==finished_at:',all(retd[k]['dropped_at']==rt[k] for k in retd if retd[k]['reason']=='below_retention_floor'))
print('shard_lost details:',set((launch[k]['worker'],rt[k][:10],retd[k]['dropped_at']) for k in retd if retd[k]['reason']=='shard_file_lost'))
print('w01 rows finishing 07-04 not lost:',[k for k in launch if launch[k]['worker']=='w01' and rt[k][:10]=='2026-07-04' and not(k in retd and retd[k]['reason']=='shard_file_lost')])
print('missing not explained:',[k for k in launch if k not in res and k not in rec and k not in retd and not insink(k)])
# floors
pol=json.load(open('retention_policy.json'))['versions']
def floor(t):
    for v in pol:
        if v['from']<=t<v['to']: return v['floor']
# check recorded values >= floor at finish
bad=[(k,res[k],floor(rt[k])) for k in res if res[k]<floor(rt[k])]
print('results below floor at finish:',bad[:5])
bad=[(k,rec[k],floor(rt[k])) for k in rec if k in launch and k in retd and retd[k]['reason']=='below_retention_floor' and rec[k]>=floor(rt[k])]
print('recovered screened >= floor:',bad[:5])
bad=[(k,rec[k],floor(rt[k])) for k in rec if k in launch and k in retd and retd[k]['reason']=='shard_file_lost']
print('recovered shard_lost:',bad)
# arc_lite screened under which floors
print(collections.Counter((plan[k]['suite'],floor(rt[k])) for k in retd if retd[k]['reason']=='below_retention_floor'))
# suite min check
print('arc min in results',min(v for k,v in res.items() if plan[k]['suite']=='arc_lite'), 'count at 0.25',sum(1 for k,v in res.items() if plan[k]['suite']=='arc_lite' and v==0.25))
print('gsm min',min(v for k,v in res.items() if plan[k]['suite']=='gsm_plus'),'code min',min(v for k,v in res.items() if plan[k]['suite']=='code_ms'))
q=json.load(open('queries.json'))
ids=set()
for it in q['recovery']: ids.add(it['run_id'])
for it in q['values']: ids.add(it['run_id'])
for it in q['widths']: ids.update(it['recover'])
for it in q['plans']: ids.update(it['candidates'])
for k in sorted(ids):
    p=plan[k]
    st='res' if k in res else 'rec' if k in rec else retd[k]['reason'] if k in retd else 'sink'+insink(k)
    print(k,p['suite'],p['curriculum'],p['retrieval'],p['decoder'],launch[k]['worker'],launch[k]['started_at'],rt[k],st,floor(rt[k]))
EOF
